summary: The exact candidate adds and numerically qualifies MiniMax-M3 SwiGLU-OAI on the existing gfx950 packed-A4/static-W4 fused MoE path while preserving the SiLU API default. Baseline support was absent/quarantined; candidate regressions, exact model-dimension routed/shared projections, and an independent adversarial GPU case passed.

tests.command: python signature inspection on recorded base
tests.what_was_measured: The prepared base imported FlyDSL from /job/repo/python/flydsl and flydsl_mxfp4_gemm1 had no activation parameter.
The base did not execute packed A4W4 correctness; it was xfailed with run=False because the path was recorded as numerically broken/memory-unsafe.
The MiniMax regression and entry-point behavior did not exist on the recorded base.
Seven gfx950 GPU tests passed, covering strict packed A4W4 correctness and MiniMax routed/shared cases at 1/2/4/16/32/256 tokens with duplicate/nonuniform routes and zero/extreme activation blocks.

Exact hidden=6144, intermediate=3072, 128 routed experts, top-k=4 plus one shared expert at 1/2/4/16/32/256 tokens. Cosine 0.99999654..0.99999821, max absolute error 0.00155360..0.00260985, finite outputs.

tests.command: reviewer-authored Python adversarial invocation of _run_mxfp_moe_e2e at candidate commit
tests.what_was_measured: Three tokens (padding boundary), E3/top-k-4 with every route duplicated, zero/1e-6/positive and negative 1e3 blocks, and non-default alpha=1.25/limit=3.5. Output was finite; cosine 0.99999702, max absolute error 0.046875, mean absolute error 0.00181039, normalized-logit error 0.000003.

gpu_execution.evidence: All candidate numerical commands executed on the assigned AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 GPU; raw logs contain compiler/runtime output and measured errors.

remaining_limitations: Kernel-level synthetic projection qualification only; no full MiniMax-M3 generation or model-weight loading was performed.
No multi-rank expert-parallel dispatch was exercised, and the packed-A4 path has no valid-mask/non-local-slot API.
Inline BF16-to-FP4 quantization and BM64 interleaved variants remain explicitly unqualified and are not part of the verified packed-A4 path.
Only gfx950 was available; behavior on other architectures is unverified.
